adjudication.rationale: In `spec/models/topic_spec.rb`, the example `it "is false if embeddable_host is blank"` is outside the inner `describe 'with an emeddable host'` `before` block, so it runs with default settings (notably `SiteSetting.embed_truncate` is false by default). Since `Topic#expandable_first_post?` was changed to `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` (host presence check removed), this test now passes trivially because `embed_truncate` is false, not because an embeddable host is blank. This is a real, diff-grounded test quality/naming issue, but not a production behavior defect.
